# Post calibrated test-bench labor actuals — operating control

Scope: Post traceable material, inventory, operation, and resource transactions from controlled shop-floor evidence.

The operator must reconcile the authoritative ERP record with the named collaboration and document evidence. A write is permitted only after the record identity, effective revision, quantity or amount, and recorded approval agree. Preserve task, lot, serial, supplier, project, and work-order references. Communicate the resulting identifier and effective date; never infer approval from silence.

instruction: You are the shop floor controller for Northstar Controls. Resolve FACTORYBENCH-015 (Post calibrated test-bench labor actuals). Match the signed timecard and calibration window to the correct operation before posting resource usage. The case is an isolated snapshot as of 2026-01-12; correlate immutable IDs and effective revisions rather than matching names alone. Evidence is distributed across Oracle Fusion, Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Slack, with inspectable files including `operating-policy.md`, `contract-or-service-control.md`, `supplier-quotation.pdf`, `supplier-lead-time-and-capacity.xlsx`, `approval-decision-log.csv`, `source-email-thread.eml`, `operations-slack-thread.json`, `drive-approval-record.json`. After the documented Oracle operation, send the scoped completion email; then add the Oracle result as a Drive comment. Return exactly: transaction_reference, item_lot, posted_quantity.
